test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A dealer sold an article at a loss of 4%. Had he sold it for Rs. 120 more, he would have gained 8%. To gain 11% he should sell the article for?
solution:
Given:

A dealer sold an article at a loss of 4%. 

If it is sold for Rs. 120 more, he would have gained 8%. 

Concept used:

SP = CP - CP × Loss%

SP = CP + CP × Gain%

Calculation:

Let the cost price be Q.

So, the selling price of the article

⇒ Q - Q × 4%

⇒ Q - Q × 0.04

⇒ 0.96Q

According to the question,

Q + Q × 8% = 0.96Q + 120

⇒ Q + Q × 0.08 = 0.96Q + 120

⇒ 1.08Q = 0.96Q + 120

⇒ 1.08Q - 0.96Q = 120

⇒ 0.12Q = 120

⇒ Q = 120/0.12

⇒ Q = 1000

Now, to gain 11% he should sell the article for 

⇒ 1000 + 1000 × 11%

⇒ 1000 + 110

⇒ Rs. 1110

**∴ To gain 11% he should sell the article for Rs. 1,110.**
